Roseanne (Japanese: ハマナ Hamana) is a minor supporting character in , , . She is one of Professor Rowan's assistants.

Like Felicity, she is not named in . The name "Roseanne" was first revealed on the TCG card , and later used in .

==In the games==
Roseanne is found in Professor Rowan's lab in Sandgem Town.

==In the manga==
 
===Pokémon Adventures===
Roseanne works as an assistant to Professor Rowan alongside Mr. Berlitz.
====History====
===== =====
Roseanne first appeared in Well Met, Weepinbell, watching over Professor Rowan's laboratory while he and Mr. Berlitz were away. After getting frustrated from being unable to find a missing document, Roseanne went outside to calm herself down. As she exited the building, Roseanne found a swarm of waiting outside.

The Yanmega begun rushing inside the building while Roseanne fled due to her fear of Pokémon. Due to the sound caused by the flapping of the Yanmega's wings, Roseanne's voice was drowned out, preventing her from calling for help. She used the laboratory's lights to send a message for help, which alerted and to come to her aid. With the help of his , Kit, Dia captured and destroyed a device that was sending commands to the Yanmega. With no one to command them, the Yanmega dispersed.

===== =====
She makes a cameo at the end of this chapter, in Alternate Dimension Showdown XI. 

===== =====
Roseanne appeared with Rowan as he informed that he discovered that Xerneas and had appeared in the Kalos region.

===== =====
Roseanne was seen in a flashback in Homecoming and the Brilliant Professional Golfer, giving Mr. Berlitz a meant to be delivered to Professor Kukui. She also appeared in Faba's flashback in Tyrant!! The Fiendish Man!.
